title: Building 7, basement light
body: Work order, timestamp 02:14:07, coffee stain in the corner. Third report this week. There is no Building 7 on the map, but the window shows its roof where no roof should be — a flat dark square catching neon that has no business reaching it. The stain is still wet.

choices.label: File it. There is no Building 7.

outcome.text: The system replies, instantly: the ticket does not exist. It is in your hand. Outside, the dark square catches another slow sweep of amber and pretends it was never there.
The annex directory has a gap between 6 and 8. Someone has erased a line. The paper is thinner there — the same thinness as the light on that roof when the cutter passes.
